_comment: Labelled prompts for scripts/agent_eval.cjs. The expected names (agent--<name>) are the agents installed on the maintainer's machine: adapt them to your own index (list them with the keys of ~/.fsr/index/claude/sources.json). A case is a hit when at least one expected agent is among the named hits; expect [] marks a negative case where no agent may be named.
